title: Botanic Gardens of Sydney —31 December 2026 free viewing areas

facts.fact: The operator announces four free viewing areas for 31 December 2026 across Royal Botanic Garden/The Domain:Mrs Macquaries Point,Fleet Steps,Tarpeian Lawn,Bennelong Lawn.
facts.excerpt: Ring in 2027 with the spectacular Sydney New Year's Eve fireworks from four fantastic free vantage points
facts.location: Opening introduction and Viewing areas list

facts.fact: Admission is managed by capacity, with no re-entry after leaving and no movement between separate viewing sites.
facts.excerpt: There are no pass outs on New Year’s Eve, if you leave the site, you will not be re-admitted
facts.location: Managed entry; following statement prohibits movement between sites

facts.fact: Public areas require no pre-registration; picnic food is allowed, but outside alcohol is prohibited, contrasting with Forecourt food rules.
facts.location: FAQ > Can I bring my own food? No BYO alcohol and no-pre-registration answers read in same FAQ.

facts.fact: Accessible viewing uses a separate ballot; the same page gives conflicting application closing dates, so the guide does not publish a deadline and directs applicants to verify the live form.
facts.excerpt: Botanic Gardens of Sydney offers a ballot ticketing system to cater for people with disability
facts.location: Accessibility section; later accessible FAQ repeats the ballot with conflicting dates. No date is selected as authoritative.

notes: Official document actually captured and read on the recorded date. Raw HTML and extracted text are preserved outside Git in artifacts/maletafeliz-new-year-ten-n 12/sources-asia-london/research. The article distinguishes 31 December 2026 from 1 January 2027, current announcements from historical copy, and public places from ticketed events. Archive photographs identify places only and do not document the future celebration. No purchase, availability guarantee, personal experience or search-demand claim is made.
